adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without guarding against `params[:embeddable_host]` being nil, which would raise `NoMethodError` on malformed/absent param wrappers. Additionally, `EmbeddableHost` has a `before_validation` block that unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)`; if `host` is nil (e.g., missing `:host` param), this will crash with `NoMethodError (nil.sub!)` before validations can run.
